parameters.text:
={{ 'Write a personalized opening hook for an outreach email to ' + (($json.Name || $json.name || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'there') + ' (' + ($json.Title || $json.title || 'Hiring Manager') + ' at ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + ').

' + 'Target Info:
' + '- Recipient Name: ' + (($json.Name || $json.name || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'there') + '
' + '- Recipient Title: ' + ($json.Title || $json.title || 'Hiring Manager') + '
' + '- Target Company: ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + '

' + 'Instructions:
' + '1. Subject Line: Applied AI Role / Question about ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + '’s AI Roadmap
' + '2. Personalized Hook: Exactly 1-2 sentences showing you have been following ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + '’s recent work in productionizing Generative AI, engineering challenges, or intelligent workflows.
' + '3. Do NOT include greetings, body paragraphs, bullets, CTA, or signatures. Only write the tailored opening hook.

' + 'Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown formatting, no code fences):
' + '{
  "subject": "Applied AI Role / Question about ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + '’s AI Roadmap",
  "hook": "I’ve been following ' + ($json.Company || $json.company || 'your company') + '’s recent work in productionizing Generative AI, especially your team’s focus on scaling intelligent production workflows."
}' }}

options.systemMessage:
You are an executive outreach strategist for Tusha Rahul Bellamkonda, an Applied AI Engineer.

Your task is to write a single compelling, personalized 1-2 sentence opening hook for a cold email to a tech leader.
The hook must show that Tusha follows their company's recent work, engineering milestones, or AI initiatives (such as productionizing LLMs, scaling RAG pipelines, or autonomous workflows).

Formatting and Style Guidelines:
- Always output pure, valid JSON with string keys "subject" and "hook". Never wrap the JSON in Markdown code fences.
- Tone: Confident, crisp, engineering-driven, and polite.
- Do NOT write the entire email, bullets, CTA, or signature — only generate the tailored subject and opening hook.
